caption: Running costs and ₹2,00,000 a year of spread capital turn a ₹3,60,000 overtime saving into just ₹8,000 a year. With a payback of 2.88 years the report calls the portal marginal, so the team should start on minimum scope.

spec.title: Fee portal: economic check
spec.aria: A left-to-right chain of the fee portal's money: manual overtime ₹3,60,000 a year, less running costs ₹1,52,000, leaves a cash saving of ₹2,08,000, less capital ₹2,00,000 a year, leaving a net benefit of ₹8,000 a year and a verdict of marginal.
